d=json.load(open('.ai/task/batch-29616b2a9c2c30bad5de-contextual-000/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-final-full.json'))
bc=d['payload']['bounded_context']
for i,c in enumerate(bc):
    t=c['context']
    head=t.split('source_facts_v1:')[0]
    print('=== %d  %s'%(i, head.strip()))
    if 'source_facts_v1:' in t:
        f=json.loads(t.split('source_facts_v1:',1)[1])
        for a in f['fact']['anchors']:
            print('   anchor',a['repository'],a['public_source_path'],a['kind'],a.get('matching_lines'))
    else:
        print('   [no facts] len',len(t))
EOF
